csv_scope_of_work: The Airport is requesting statements of qualifications for the purpose of selecting Company(ies) (herein referred to as the Company ) to provide on-call planning services. All Services required will be scoped and funded by individual task orders (Task Order) issued by the Airport.

relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily an on-call planning framework-style service without a defined structural project.
- Scope focuses on planning, master planning, redevelopment, environmental, and transportation planning rather than structural engineering.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building is specified.
- The sbp guidance explicitly rejects pure urban/open space planning, environmental/feasibility-type services, and framework agreements without technical specification.
- Airport context could be strategically interesting in general, but the tender lacks a concrete structural design component.
